description: Competitive Gaming (a Test Lab badge) looks at esports and gaming responsibly: gaming history, online safety, balancing gaming with sleep and physical activity, the technology behind competitive play, leadership and service in the gaming community, and careers in the industry.
outlineNote: Competitive Gaming is a Test Lab badge. Its official page and digital guide group the requirements into history of gaming, gamer safety, health and balance, community connection, technology, leadership and service, and careers, but the two sources worded some items differently, so no requirement outline is published yet.
